31. (Currently amended) A system for treating obesity, the system comprising: a gastric space filler comprising a first balloon connected to a second balloon by a conduit, wherein the gastric space filler is configured to occupy a substantial volume of a gastric cavity in the human patient in an inflated state; and an instrument throughput channel extending through the conduit, wherein the instrument throughput channel is configured to receive instruments, __wherein the first balloon and the second balloon are positioned in a non-overlapping configuration within the gastric cavity__.

34. (Currently amended) The system of claim 31 wherein the gastric space filler further comprises a coupling mechanism __at a proximal end of the gastric space filler__ configured to facilitate engagement with a retrieval device for removal of the gastric space filler from the gastric cavity via the esophagus, __wherein the coupling mechanism comprises at least one of a plug, a suture loop, or a grasping element__.

35. (Previously presented)

36. (Currently amended) The system of claim 31 wherein the conduit comprises an inter-balloon section spacing the first balloon apart from the second balloon, and wherein the inter-balloon section has a length of about __5-10 mm__.
